text: and the price. Fish Audio's own service charges $50 per million bytes of text. My card, speaking 16 lines at once, needs about 2 hours and 20 Euro cents of electricity for the same million bytes. At that rate, the card pays for itself after about 600 hours of speech or 720 with VAT.
